Business Email Assignment

Read the instructions carefully before you begin.

Consider the importance of professional communication when reaching out to community members and businesses.

"Good communication is the bridge between confusion and clarity."

The Assignment:

Write a formal business email to a local business owner proposing a partnership for an upcoming school fundraiser.

Ensure your email includes:

  • A clear and professional subject line.
  • An appropriate salutation and sign-off.
  • A brief explanation of the fundraiser and its goals.
  • A specific, polite request for partnership or donation.

Note: Organize your ideas and check your work for spelling, punctuation, formatting, and grammar.
